name: Hotel Preet Resort Satara
why_special: Senior Satara highway-side resort on NH-48 — 50 rooms, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant. The reliable Satara base for Kaas Plateau (Sep–Oct flower bloom) and Thoseghar Falls day-trippers.

name: Hotel Yatra Inn Satara
why_special: Mid-range business hotel at Powai Naka junction — multi-cuisine vegetarian restaurant, walking distance to Ajinkyatara Fort base. The clean budget pick for Satara town stays.
